# --instructions--

编写一个函数 `countWords(words: List<String>): Map<String, Int>`，返回一个 map，将每个不同的单词与它在列表中出现的次数配对。

函数调用示例：
```kotlin
println(countWords(listOf("a", "b", "a")))
// prints {a=2, b=1}
```

# --asserts--

`countWords(listOf("a", "b", "a"))` 必须返回 `{a=2, b=1}`

```kotlin
    tryCatch(countWords(listOf("a", "b", "a")) == mapOf("a" to 2, "b" to 1))
```

`countWords(listOf("hi", "hi", "hi"))` 必须返回 `{hi=3}`

```kotlin
    tryCatch(countWords(listOf("hi", "hi", "hi")) == mapOf("hi" to 3))
```

对空列表调用 `countWords` 必须返回空 map

```kotlin
    tryCatch(countWords(listOf()) == mapOf<String, Int>())
```

# --solutions--

```kotlin
fun countWords(words: List<String>): Map<String, Int> {
    val counts = mutableMapOf<String, Int>()
    for (word in words) {
        counts[word] = counts.getOrDefault(word, 0) + 1
    }
    return counts
}
```
